messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED: High 429/over-throttle rate observed on rate-enforcer-prod-east. Autosystem flagged canary rollout `rlv3-canary-2026-03-15` as correlated. Affected: subset of token-based exemptions and per-customer token accounting. Paging @oncall and infra.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout `rlv3-canary-2026-03-15` started at 09:12:07 UTC, cohort=10%, commit=bf3a9c2, config: ratecap_v3 enabled
samantha: ack. I'm on. putting myself as incident lead. quick summary pls (who's on infra?)
emily: I'm on SRE. seeing 429 spike starting ~09:14, error-rate up to 18% on /v1/generate for some tenants. TL;DR: rate-enforcer returning 429 even for token types that should be exempt.
raj: eng-runtime here. early hypothesis: exemptions table lookup is returning stale shards for the canary path. There's a change in how token namespaces are hashed in bf3a9c2.
mike: product FYI — we have a couple of paying customers hitting errors. Tina, support: any tickets?
tina: support here. Yes — two high-priority tickets from acme-inc and betaapp. Both show repeated 429s and missing exemptions. Ticket links: <https://support.redwood/acme/INC-3942> <https://support.redwood/betaapp/INC-3943>
olga: customer-ops: acme says this is affecting live chat — they saw sudden rate limits and had to fall back. ETA impact: 09:14-09:23. They've paused new requests.
matt: eng-platform — checking canary traffic routing. Canary percentage is 10% as expected. No infra autoscale triggers yet.
emily: grabbing logs — snippet:

```
[09:14:02] rate-enforcer-prod-east ERROR request_id=ZxQ1 token_type=chat_stream tenant=acme code=429 reason="rate_limited" exemption_lookup=MISS
[09:14:02] rate-enforcer-prod-east DEBUG exemptions_key=namespace-v2 shard=12 cache_hit=false
[09:14:03] kv-cache WARN eviction key=namespace-v2 shard=12
```

raj: that `exemption_lookup=MISS` aligns with the hashing change. Rolling back hashing change should restore mapping. I can flip feature flag `ratecap.v3.hashing` to `off` in prod immediately if ops approve.
samantha: decision: initiate kill-switch for the canary path first (min blast radius). Two actions: 1) flip canary routing to 0% (stop new canary traffic), 2) flip `ratecap.v3.hashing` flag to off. Which one first?
emily: flip routing first (so no additional canary traffic enters). Then flip flag. Routing flip ID: `canary-cohort-rlv3 -> off` (manual).
matt: executed `canary-cohort-rlv3 -> 0%` at 09:16:11 UTC. Confirming no new canary sessions routed.
raj: I'll prepare flag flip command. Proposed command:

```
# feature flag toggle (prod control-plane)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  https://flags.redwood/api/toggles/ratecap.v3.hashing \
  -d '{"value":false}'
```

emily: do it. We'll monitor 429 rate and exemption cache hits.
raj: toggled `ratecap.v3.hashing=false` at 09:16:43 UTC.
emily: seeing immediate reduction in new 429s from canary cohort. exemption_lookup now = HIT for majority:

```
[09:17:02] rate-enforcer-prod-east INFO request_id=ZxQ9 token_type=chat_stream tenant=acme code=200 exemption_lookup=HIT
```

incident-bot: Incident update: mitigation in progress. Can confirm canary stopped and flag rolled back. Continue monitoring for 30m.
tina: telling acme & betaapp support that we rolled back canary and are monitoring. sending message to account teams.
mike: product — rough impact window estimate for customers: ~09:14-09:17. We'll prepare a customer-facing timeline once SRE/eng confirm stability.
emily: measuring error-rate graph — 429 rate peaked at 18% at 09:15, back to baseline (~0.8%) by 09:18. No increase in latency.
raj: root cause (short): hashing change in bf3a9c2 led to mismatched shard key used by exemptions cache. Combined with a race on shard bootstrap for canary instances, exemptions table returned misses for a subset of tokens.
matt: followups: add a canary-only integration test for exemption lookup, add canary bootstrap healthcheck to block routing until exemptions cache warm.
samantha: action items:
- eng-runtime (raj): revert hashing change in the branch and add regression test (owner: raj) — due EOD
- eng-platform (matt): add warmup/healthcheck gating for canary routing (owner: matt) — due 48h
- SRE (emily): add alert rule for exemption_cache_miss_rate > 1% sustained (owner: emily) — due tomorrow
- support (tina): draft customer timeline for acme & betaapp (owner: tina) — send within 2h
olga: acme confirmed services restored and thanked the team. pls include their note in timeline.
mike: ok to close pager when metrics stable for 30m. keeping incident open for postmortem.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation applied. Monitoring continues. Next update at 09:46 UTC or on-demand.
samantha: thanks all. great rapid coordination. we'll do a short postmortem and link to runbook. closing primary pager once 30m check passes. :thumbsup:

# end of thread
